lines.text: Many learners say: We arrived to the airport.
Better: We arrived at the airport.
Do not use to after arrive.
At! We arrived at the station.

data.why: Do not use to after arrive.

native.tip: في العربية نقول «وصلنا إلى»، أما arrive فلا تأخذ to: “We arrived at the airport.” وليس “We arrived to the airport.”

en.tip: In Arabic we say «وصلنا إلى», but arrive does not take to: “We arrived at the airport.” not “We arrived to the airport.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “We arrived to the airport.” 😅 In Arabic we say «وصلنا إلى», but arrive does not take to, so the right sentence is “We arrived at the airport.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
